Hustle, The - Detroit Streets.name: The Hustle: Detroit Streets
Hustle, The - Detroit Streets.summary: The Hustle: Detroit Streets is a billiards game for the Xbox, PSP, and Playstation 2.

Miami Vice.name: Miami Vice
Miami Vice.summary: Playing as Sonny Crockett and Ricardo Tubbs, the buddy-cop duo from the 80's TV series of the same name, fight to take down a drug ring led by Manuel Ortega in this third-person shooter.

Warriors, The.name: The Warriors
Warriors, The.summary: Based on the 1979 movie of the same name. A battle on the New York streets. The armies of the night number 60,000 strong, and tonight they're all after The Warriors - a street gang wrongly accused of killing a rival gang leader.
